- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Popular Art Deco jewelry styles include long dangling earrings, cocktail rings, brooches, and stacked bracelets.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] User's inherited earrings may have characteristic features of Art Deco jewelry, such as geometric shapes and clean lines.

- [ASSISTANT_SAID] User should look for specific features in the emerald brooch, such as the setting, geometric surround, filigree or milgrain, diamond accents, and maker's mark.
